questions: Does every member pay the same fixed amount each round, or can each person pay any amount (including paying more than once in the same round)?
Must rounds go in order (round 2 opens only after round 1 is collected), or can payments be recorded for any round number at any time?
Does the person collecting a round have to be a member who paid into that round, or can any member of the group collect?
answers: No, record whatever each member actually paid; the pot is the total paid in for that round.
